_spec_note: Informational catalog. Agents discover these tools in-page via document.modelContext.registerTool (W3C WebML CG draft; navigator.modelContext kept as fallback for Chrome 146-148 Canary). Dual API: Declarative (forms) + Imperative (JS).
name: 312Deals
description: Chicago's best food & drink deals — {{deals}} deals at {{venues}} venues across {{neighborhoods}} neighborhoods. Happy hours, daily specials, brunch, late-night, chains, game day, seasonal offers. Verified weekly.

coverage.geographic: Chicago IL metro — {{neighborhoods}} neighborhoods (Chicago city + suburbs)

tools.name: search_chicago_deals
tools.description: Find food and drink deals across {{neighborhoods}} Chicago neighborhoods and suburbs. Covers happy hours, daily specials (taco tuesday, wing wednesday), brunch deals, late-night eats, chain app promotions (McDonald's, Chipotle, BWW), game day specials, and seasonal offers at {{venues}} verified venues.

tools.name: deals_near_location
tools.description: Find active deals near a Chicago address, landmark, or coordinates. Geo-proximity search. Give either address or lat/lng.

tools.name: get_venue_deals
tools.description: Get all current deals for a specific Chicago venue by name or ID.

tools.name: chicago_deal_of_the_day
tools.description: Get today's featured deal — the best value deal active right now.

tools.name: chicago_chain_deals
tools.description: National chain deals in Chicago: McDonald's, Chipotle, BWW, Portillo's, etc.

tools.name: chicago_neighborhood_deals_summary
tools.description: Neighborhood deal summary — venue count, deal count, top deals, cuisine breakdown.

tools.name: plan_chicago_deal_crawl
tools.description: Plan a multi-stop deal crawl across Chicago venues. Optimizes route, timing, and savings.

tools.name: get_order_link
tools.description: Direct online-ordering URL for a Chicago restaurant (venue's own ordering page when available, DoorDash search fallback).

tools.name: get_reservation_link
tools.description: Reservation booking URL (OpenTable or Resy) for a Chicago restaurant, plus which platform is available.

tools.name: submit_chicago_deal
tools.description: Submit a new deal tip for human verification (write action; the agent should confirm details with the user first).

tools.name: tonight_get_plan
tools.description: Read the shared 'Tonight' plan on the page: ordered stops, which ones the user locked, and constraints. Call before changing the plan.

tools.name: tonight_set_constraints
tools.description: Set budget per person, start/end time, group size, max stops, and anchor neighborhood for tonight's plan.

tools.name: tonight_add_stop
tools.description: Add a venue (and optionally a specific deal) to the user's Tonight plan at a 1-based position. Appears in the panel marked 'added by agent'.

tools.name: tonight_remove_stop
tools.description: Remove a stop by id or number. Refuses if the user locked it.

tools.name: tonight_move_stop
tools.description: Move a stop to a new 1-based position. Locked stops cannot be moved or displaced.

tools.name: tonight_order_by_deal_window
tools.description: Reorder unlocked stops so deal windows are visited in order (earliest-ending first, all-day last). Locked stops keep their slots.

tools.name: tonight_clear
tools.description: Clear the plan; keeps locked stops unless keep_locked is false.

collaboration.surface: Tonight panel (every page) — a shared plan the person and their agent edit together
person_can: lock a stop so the agent must plan around it
collaboration.rule: Locked stops are constraints, not suggestions: agent mutations against them return a structured refusal.

legal.data_license: Display permitted via agents; bulk copying or resale prohibited
